metadata.analysis_summary: This attack graph identifies verified attack paths in Kaseya Unitrends Backup Software through rigorous multi-round analysis and independent factual verification. All links passed both frequency threshold (≥3/5 candidates) and independent factcheck against source data.

attack_clusters.name: Authentication Bypass Cluster
attack_clusters.description: Multiple authentication bypass vulnerabilities leading to RCE with root privileges across different interfaces

attack_clusters.name: Privilege Escalation Chain
attack_clusters.description: Privilege escalation from read-only user to admin, enabling authenticated RCE

attack_clusters.name: PostgreSQL Privilege Escalation Chain
attack_clusters.description: Weak credentials leading to wguest access, then privilege escalation to postgres user

attack_clusters.name: Apache User Chain
attack_clusters.description: Local privilege escalation to apache user, then arbitrary file read via sudo misconfiguration

attack_clusters.name: VaultServer Cluster
attack_clusters.description: Multiple vulnerabilities in the privileged vaultServer component

nodes.vulnerability_type: Authentication Bypass leading to Remote Code Execution
nodes.description: Authentication bypass in bpserverd proprietary protocol leading to arbitrary command execution with root privileges
nodes.precondition: network access to bpserverd service through xinetd
nodes.postcondition: arbitrary command execution with root privileges
nodes.role: Central Node - Primary Attack Entry Point

nodes.vulnerability_type: Input Validation Bypass leading to Authentication Bypass and RCE
nodes.description: Input validation bypass in api/storage web interface leading to authentication bypass and RCE with root privileges
nodes.precondition: network access to api/storage web interface
nodes.postcondition: authentication bypassed and arbitrary commands executed with root privileges

nodes.vulnerability_type: Authentication Bypass leading to Command Injection
nodes.description: Authentication bypass in user interface allowing command injection via /api/hosts parameters
nodes.precondition: network access to user interface /api/hosts endpoint
nodes.postcondition: authentication bypassed and arbitrary command injection via backquotes

nodes.description: Privilege escalation from read-only user to admin
Authenticated remote code execution in server software

nodes.vulnerability_type: Remote Code Execution via Command Injection
nodes.description: Multiple functions in bpserverd daemon vulnerable to RCE as root via untrusted input passed to system calls
nodes.precondition: ability to send untrusted input to bpserverd daemon

nodes.vulnerability_type: Local Privilege Escalation via Insecure File Permissions
nodes.description: World writable file allows local users to execute code as apache user
Weak default password for PostgreSQL wguest account
nodes.precondition: knowledge of weak password or brute force capability

nodes.vulnerability_type: Privilege Escalation via SQL Trigger Injection
nodes.description: Privilege escalation from wguest to postgres user via SQL trigger function injection
nodes.postcondition: postgres user privileges obtained via trigger function injection

nodes.vulnerability_type: Arbitrary File Write leading to Privilege Escalation
nodes.description: Privileged vaultServer can be leveraged to create arbitrary writable files for privilege escalation
nodes.precondition: ability to interact with privileged vaultServer
nodes.postcondition: arbitrary file creation and privilege escalation

nodes.description: Format string vulnerability in privileged vaultServer via crafted HTTP request
nodes.precondition: ability to send crafted HTTP requests to vaultServer
nodes.postcondition: potential code execution in privileged vaultServer context

nodes.description: Unauthenticated remote buffer overflow in vaultServer component

nodes.vulnerability_type: Arbitrary File Read via Sudo Misconfiguration
nodes.description: Apache user can read arbitrary files including /etc/shadow via insecure sudo rule
nodes.postcondition: ability to read sensitive files including /etc/shadow

links.description: Both exploit authentication bypass mechanisms in Unitrends Backup < 10.0.0 to achieve RCE with root privileges through different interfaces (bpserverd vs api/storage)
links.evidence: Both CVEs target Unitrends Backup < 10.0.0, exploit authentication bypass vulnerabilities, and result in arbitrary command execution with root privileges

links.description: Both leverage authentication bypass vulnerabilities in Unitrends web interfaces to enable command execution
links.evidence: Both CVEs exploit authentication bypass in Unitrends interfaces (bpserverd vs /api/hosts) to achieve command execution

links.description: Both target the bpserverd daemon to achieve RCE as root, exploiting input validation issues
links.evidence: Both CVEs target the same component (bpserverd daemon) and achieve arbitrary code execution as root through input validation weaknesses

links.description: Both exploit authentication bypass mechanisms in web interfaces for command execution
links.evidence: Both CVEs leverage authentication bypass in web interfaces (api/storage vs /api/hosts) to enable command execution

links.description: Admin privileges obtained from CVE-2021-40385 satisfy the user authentication requirement for CVE-2021-40387, enabling authenticated RCE
links.evidence: CVE-2021-40385 postcondition (admin privileges) directly satisfies CVE-2021-40387 precondition (user authentication)

links.description: Apache user execution from CVE-2021-43034 satisfies the apache user precondition for CVE-2021-43043, enabling arbitrary file read
links.evidence: CVE-2021-43034 postcondition (apache user access) exactly matches CVE-2021-43043 precondition (apache user access)

links.description: Wguest account access from CVE-2021-43036 directly satisfies the wguest account access precondition for CVE-2021-43038, enabling privilege escalation to postgres user
links.evidence: CVE-2021-43036 postcondition (wguest PostgreSQL account access) exactly matches CVE-2021-43038 precondition (wguest PostgreSQL account access)

links.description: Both exploit vulnerabilities in the privileged vaultServer component
links.evidence: Both CVEs target the privileged vaultServer component with different vulnerability types (arbitrary file write vs format string)

links.description: Both target the vaultServer component with different exploitation techniques
links.evidence: Both CVEs exploit the vaultServer component (arbitrary file write vs buffer overflow)

links.description: Both exploit vaultServer vulnerabilities with different attack vectors (format string vs buffer overflow)
links.evidence: Both CVEs target the vaultServer component with memory corruption vulnerabilities
